Initially, they were struggling to cope with the aftermath of a big argument with Nate, which led to feelings of exhaustion and self-doubt. They found solace in writing and talking to a supportive friend, who encouraged them to focus on self-worth and take things one day at a time. As time passed, Taylor continued to grapple with their emotions, particularly when Nate reached out to apologize and propose a meeting. Taylor felt conflicted, wanting closure but also fearing the potential consequences.
